cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Validation Analyst to join our team.
Please note, GMP/Regulated lab, CSV experience is required.
[Company name masked] needs Validation Analysts with CSV experience in a GMP/Regulated Lab environment to provide basic business/system support of software systems and/or laboratory instrumentation. You would work with staff of various departments and the client to initiate and complete Performance Qualification (PQ) validation and facilitate the validation process and implementation of system upgrades, including guiding, testing, supporting the introduction, and ongoing support of software systems.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Participates as a validation representative at project team meetings and completes assigned action items. Provides direction for future releases to software systems; reviews and approves/rejects change requests. Communicates proactively with all project team members and provides regular feedback to management concerning timeline/budget or resource constraints.
Provides validation support for new releases and modifications to applications throughout the software development life cycle. Prepares validation plans, test cases and validation summary reports, and executes test cases.
Reviews and approves all change controls associated with validated systems per SOP. Reviews PQ and change control documentation with leadership per SOP.
Ensures test scripts challenge the functional requirements and adequately demonstrate that the application meets the expectations of the business customer.
Executes test scripts accurately to produce evidence that the computer system consistently performs its intended functions accurately and reliably, proving the software functions correctly. Creates, updates, and manages sufficient data within the testing environment to accurately test software functionality. Works with leadership to address any PQ related issues arising from client or internal audits.
Manages assignments to meet deadlines and produce high quality deliverables. Remains familiar with relevant contractual obligations, sponsor expectations, applicable regulations, and SOPs.
Participates in the identification of user requirements and system design and assists in the preparation and review of system documentation such as requirements and design specifications for software systems and/or instrumentation.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 2+ years)
Preferred Requirements
CSV experience in a GMP/Regulated Lab environment

[Company name masked] needs (2) Validation Analysts with CSV experience in a GMP/Regulated Lab environment to provide basic business/system support of software systems and/or laboratory instrumentation. You would work with staff of various departments and the client to initiate and complete Performance Qualification (PQ) validation and facilitate the validation process and implementation of system upgrades, including guiding, testing, supporting the introduction, and ongoing support of software systems. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of CSV and GMP validation processes.
cond_0508.responsibilities:
Participates as a validation representative at project team meetings and completes assigned action items. Provides direction for future releases to software systems; reviews and approves/rejects change requests. Communicates proactively with all project team members and provides regular feedback to management concerning timeline/budget or resource constraints.
Provides validation support for new releases and modifications to applications throughout the software development life cycle. Prepares validation plans, test cases and validation summary reports, and executes test cases.
Reviews and approves all change controls associated with validated systems per SOP. Reviews PQ and change control documentation with leadership per SOP.
Ensures test scripts challenge the functional requirements and adequately demonstrate that the application meets the expectations of the business customer.
Executes test scripts accurately to produce evidence that the computer system consistently performs its intended functions accurately and reliably, proving the software functions correctly. Creates, updates, and manages sufficient data within the testing environment to accurately test software functionality. Works with leadership to address any PQ related issues arising from client or internal audits.
Manages assignments to meet deadlines and produce high quality deliverables. Remains familiar with relevant contractual obligations, sponsor expectations, applicable regulations, and SOPs.
Participates in the identification of user requirements and system design and assists in the preparation and review of system documentation such as requirements and design specifications for software systems and/or instrumentation.
cond_0508.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 2+ years)
Preferred Requirements
CSV experience in a GMP/Regulated Lab environment

cond_0578.intro: We are looking for a Validation Analyst to join our team.
cond_0578.responsibilities:
Participates as a validation representative at project team meetings and completes assigned action items. Provides direction for future releases to software systems; reviews and approves/rejects change requests. Communicates proactively with all project team members and provides regular feedback to management concerning timeline/budget or resource constraints.
Provides validation support for new releases and modifications to applications throughout the software development life cycle. Prepares validation plans, test cases and validation summary reports, and executes test cases.
Reviews and approves all change controls associated with validated systems per SOP. Reviews PQ and change control documentation with leadership per SOP.
Ensures test scripts challenge the functional requirements and adequately demonstrate that the application meets the expectations of the business customer.
Executes test scripts accurately to produce evidence that the computer system consistently performs its intended functions accurately and reliably, proving the software functions correctly. Creates, updates, and manages sufficient data within the testing environment to accurately test software functionality. Works with leadership to address any PQ related issues arising from client or internal audits.
Manages assignments to meet deadlines and produce high quality deliverables. Remains familiar with relevant contractual obligations, sponsor expectations, applicable regulations, and SOPs.
Participates in the identification of user requirements and system design and assists in the preparation and review of system documentation such as requirements and design specifications for software systems and/or instrumentation.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent formal academic/vocational qualification required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in a comparable validation or regulated systems role, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality results.
Deep knowledge of CSV (Computer System Validation) practices in a GMP or regulated lab environment.

Advanced knowledge of the software development life cycle as it applies to validated systems.
Strong command of change control processes, SOP compliance, and PQ documentation review.
Exceptional communication skills and strong ability to coordinate across departments and with external clients.

[Company name masked] needs Validation Analysts with CSV experience in a GMP/Regulated Lab environment to provide basic business/system support of software systems and/or laboratory instrumentation. You would work with staff of various departments and the client to initiate and complete Performance Qualification (PQ) validation and facilitate the validation process and implementation of system upgrades, including guiding, testing, supporting the introduction, and ongoing support of software systems.
cond_0604.responsibilities:
Essential Functions:
Participates as a validation representative at project team meetings and completes assigned action items. Provides direction for future releases to software systems; reviews and approves/rejects change requests. Communicates proactively with all project team members and provides regular feedback to management concerning timeline/budget or resource constraints.
Provides validation support for new releases and modifications to applications throughout the software development life cycle. Prepares validation plans, test cases and validation summary reports, and executes test cases.
Reviews and approves all change controls associated with validated systems per SOP. Reviews PQ and change control documentation with leadership per SOP.
Ensures test scripts challenge the functional requirements and adequately demonstrate that the application meets the expectations of the business customer.
Executes test scripts accurately to produce evidence that the computer system consistently performs its intended functions accurately and reliably, proving the software functions correctly. Creates, updates, and manages sufficient data within the testing environment to accurately test software functionality. Works with leadership to address any PQ related issues arising from client or internal audits.
Manages assignments to meet deadlines and produce high quality deliverables. Remains familiar with relevant contractual obligations, sponsor expectations, applicable regulations, and SOPs.
Participates in the identification of user requirements and system design and assists in the preparation and review of system documentation such as requirements and design specifications for software systems and/or instrumentation.
cond_0604.requirements:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 2+ years)

Our commitment to equal gender representation across all levels allows us to create an environment where every employee can bring their unique perspective and experiences to work, enabling us to drive profitability, increase productivity, and unleash innovation. [Company name masked] needs (2) Validation Analysts with CSV experience in a GMP/Regulated Lab environment to provide basic business/system support of software systems and/or laboratory instrumentation. You would work with staff of various departments and the client to initiate and complete Performance Qualification (PQ) validation and facilitate the validation process and implementation of system upgrades, including guiding, testing, supporting the introduction, and ongoing support of software systems. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of CSV and GMP validation processes.
cond_0634.responsibilities:
Participates as a validation representative at project team meetings and completes assigned action items. Provides direction for future releases to software systems; reviews and approves/rejects change requests. Communicates proactively with all project team members and provides regular feedback to management concerning timeline/budget or resource constraints.
Provides validation support for new releases and modifications to applications throughout the software development life cycle. Prepares validation plans, test cases and validation summary reports, and executes test cases.
Reviews and approves all change controls associated with validated systems per SOP. Reviews PQ and change control documentation with leadership per SOP.
Ensures test scripts challenge the functional requirements and adequately demonstrate that the application meets the expectations of the business customer.
Executes test scripts accurately to produce evidence that the computer system consistently performs its intended functions accurately and reliably, proving the software functions correctly. Creates, updates, and manages sufficient data within the testing environment to accurately test software functionality. Works with leadership to address any PQ related issues arising from client or internal audits.
Manages assignments to meet deadlines and produce high quality deliverables. Remains familiar with relevant contractual obligations, sponsor expectations, applicable regulations, and SOPs.
Participates in the identification of user requirements and system design and assists in the preparation and review of system documentation such as requirements and design specifications for software systems and/or instrumentation.
cond_0634.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 2+ years)
Preferred Requirements
CSV experience in a GMP/Regulated Lab environment
